text: GDScript is a high-level, object-oriented, gradually typed language built specifically for Godot scripting
quote: GDScript is a high-level, object-oriented, imperative, and gradually typed programming language built for Godot.

text: C# scripting is supported as an alternative to GDScript, running on the modern .NET runtime
quote: C# is a high-level programming language developed by Microsoft. In Godot, it is implemented with the modern .NET runtime.

text: Godot can be driven entirely from the command line for developers who prefer CLI workflows
quote: Some developers like using the command line extensively. Godot is designed to be friendly to them, so here are the steps for working entirely from the command line.

text: Editor plugins can be built entirely in GDScript and standard scenes without restarting the editor
quote: A plugin is a great way to extend the editor with useful tools. It can be made entirely with GDScript and standard scenes, without even reloading the editor.

text: Scripts can implement an EditorScript _run() method to be executed directly from the editor's Script Editor
quote: Scripts extending this class and implementing its _run() method can be executed from the Script Editor's File > Run menu option (or by pressing Ctrl + Shift + X) while the editor is running.

text: Games can be exported with one click to desktop, mobile, web, and console platforms
quote: Games can be exported with one click to a number of platforms, including the major desktop platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows), mobile platforms (Android, iOS), as well as Web-based platforms and consoles.

text: Godot is free and open source under the permissive MIT license, with no royalties or fees
quote: Godot is completely free and open source under the very permissive MIT license. No strings attached, no royalties, nothing.

text: A Node and Scene composition system is the core way to build game content in the editor
quote: Godot's Node and Scene system gives you both power and flexibility to create anything.

text: A dedicated 2D rendering engine with true 2D pixel coordinates makes 2D a first-class workflow
quote: Make crisp and performant 2D games with Godot's dedicated 2D rendering engine with real 2D pixel coordinates and 2D nodes.

text: Engine code can be written in GDScript, C#, C++, or custom bindings via GDExtension
quote: Keep your code modular with an object-oriented API using Godot's own GDScript, C#, C++, or bring your own using GDExtension.

text: Assets placed in the project folder are automatically imported and cached internally in a hidden imported-resources folder
quote: Godot will automatically import these files internally and keep the imported resources hidden in a res://.godot/imported/ folder.

text: A high-level networking API trades fine-grained control for ease of use in multiplayer projects
quote: it's worthwhile to consider Godot's high-level networking API, which sacrifices some of the fine-grained control of low-level networking for greater ease of use.

text: Official docs provide compilation instructions to build the engine from source for every supported platform
quote: See the official docs for compilation instructions for every supported platform.

text: An Asset Library offers categorized ready-made 2D/3D tools, shaders, scripts, templates, and demo projects
quote: Godot Asset Library ... Category Any 2D Tools 3D Tools Shaders Materials Tools Scripts Misc Templates Projects Demos

text: Import parameters can be changed in bulk across multiple assets at once
quote: Changing the import parameters of several assets at the same time is also possible.

text: Godot can be used alongside external text editors like Sublime Text or VS Code instead of the built-in editor
quote: Godot can be used with an external text editor, such as Sublime Text or Visual Studio Code.

text: A headless display server and dummy audio driver let Godot run without a GPU or display, for dedicated servers
quote: you'll need to run Godot with the `headless` display server and `Dummy` audio driver.

text: Custom import plugins let developers add support for new resource types treated as first-class assets
quote: An import plugin is a special type of editor tool that allows custom resources to be imported by Godot and be treated as first-class resources.

text: An EditorInterface API lets scripts programmatically control the editor window, scenes, previews, and resources
quote: EditorInterface gives you control over Godot editor's window. It allows customizing the window, saving and (re-)loading scenes, rendering mesh previews, inspecting and editing resources and objects

text: Modified or unmodified versions of the engine can be redistributed, even commercially, under a different license
quote: You can distribute unmodified and changed versions of Godot Engine, even commercially and under a different license (including proprietary)

text: Godot's license does not extend to games made with it — creators fully own and can license their own content
quote: Godot Engine's license terms and copyright do not apply to the content you create with it; you are free to license your games how you see best fit, and will be their sole copyright owner(s).
